name: M7.RawCoverage.translate_supports
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) (s t : ZMod N), M7.Action.act (M7.Action.translate s t) c = (M7.Domain.shift c.1 s, M7.Domain.shift c.2 t)
guidance: Unfold actual act, translate, affine and Domain.shift. Unit one and exchange false reduce pointwise; congruence of the two finite images. Return tactic lines without leading by.
